def load():

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def transform(grid):
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    # separator color: appears in complete full rows/cols
    sr=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(grid[i]))==1]
    sc=[j for j in range(W) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1]
    sep=grid[sr[0]][0] if sr else grid[0][sc[0]]
    rem=Counter({k:v for k,v in cnt.items() if k!=sep})
    bg=rem.most_common(1)[0][0]
    dot=[k for k in rem if k!=bg][0]
    ridx=[i for i in range(H) if i not in sr]; cidx=[j for j in range(W) if j not in sc]
    def groups(idx):
        g=[];cur=[idx[0]]
        for x in idx[1:]:
            if x==cur[-1]+1:cur.append(x)
            else:g.append(cur);cur=[x]
        g.append(cur);return g
    gr,gc=groups(ridx),groups(cidx)
    res=[]
    for rr in gr:
        row=[]
        for cc in gc:
            n=sum(1 for r in rr for c in cc if grid[r][c]==dot)
            row.append(1 if n>=2 else bg)
        res.append(row)
    return res
